senses.definition: vb. be sick (?; cf. Syriac ܢܰܣ id., and especially ܢܰܣܺܝܣ debilis, infirmus, aegrotans, etc., PS2387; 𝔗 נְסַס be sad; Assyrian nasâsu, wail, lament DlHWB 427; Arabic نَسَّ is go at a gentle pace);—only
Pt. act. (si vera l.) כִּמְסֹס נֹסֵס Is 10:18 like the wasting away of a sick man (so Thes Ew De Che Di Du).
